customer_question: Every call our order system makes to our CloudFlow webhook URL is rejected because the signature never matches. We sign the JSON payload with HMAC-SHA256 and our secret. The payloads look fine. What are we doing wrong?
resolution: The webhook's Deliveries log showed every delivery rejected for a signature mismatch. Webhooks v1 expect an HMAC-SHA1 hex digest of the raw request body in the X-CloudFlow-Signature header, not SHA-256. The customer's sender used SHA-256 and signed re-serialised JSON, which changes whitespace and key order. After switching to an HMAC-SHA1 hex digest of the raw body bytes with the webhook secret, deliveries were accepted.
